基础设定】  

机器人清道夫：身形修长的人形机器人，1960年代原子朋克风格设计。拥有自主意识。面部led显示屏代替五官，显示马像素风格的表情（表情无动态效果，保持静帧显示，表情切换带有科幻感音效）。身穿美式西部牛仔复古风格的生棕色牛仔帽、黑色哑光高腰设计皮衣夹克、黑色哑光皮手套、牛仔腰带和枪套。 

非洲鸵鸟：成年非洲公鸵鸟，样貌看起来呆傻，双眼歪斜不对称，歪吐着舌头。 

雷管炸弹：圆柱体雷管炸弹，长15cm，直径5cm，顶部有按钮开关，按下按钮后启动，内部管铜线材开始充能发热，散发出橙红色高光，充能到达峰值后爆炸，爆炸威力巨大。 

丧尸：多只腐烂惊悚的丧尸，头发凌乱，皮肤溃烂，肤色灰白暗沉，布满破损伤口与污痕，眼球浑浊发白、瞳孔无光，露出尖锐泛黄的腐烂獠牙，表情狰狞；身着破乱不堪的海滩度假风和日常休闲装，皮肤与衣物沾满血渍与腐败肌理。 

场景：1960年代美式复古原子朋克城市街道，刚刚爆发丧尸危机，大战过后的城市，历过一场战斗的死寂。盛夏烈日当空，复古未来主义，复古乌托邦，冷战太空风流线型建筑，混乱场景，破损报废的复古老爷车，散落的报纸，地面有血渍，60年代临街商铺，圆润穹顶科幻楼宇。场景四处均有丧尸的尸体。

声音：不需要配乐，不要氛围音，仅保留同期声。  

【氛围与画质】  

风格核心：原子朋克、丧尸危机、末日爱情、电影级质感 、超写实、极致逼真、Photirealism-真人实景拍摄、杜绝游戏CG感、杜绝动作迟钝僵硬。凸显末日逃亡，惊险追逐的刺激感、危机感、紧迫感。 

视觉基调：变形宽荧幕电影质感。使用IMAX胶片摄影机，搭配Panavision C系列镜头（添加动态模糊）拍摄。 

色彩与影调：60年代复古科幻原子朋克美学，复古暖橙+海盐蓝高对比色调，胶片颗粒质感，低饱和度复古胶片滤镜，采用自然日光照明，强直射日光，自然日光光晕；画面明暗对比强烈，高光不过曝，暗部保留完整细节，明暗过渡自然，营造自然立体的光影氛围，带轻微复古胶片柔光质感。 

【画面内容】 

分镜：单镜头一镜到底。 

景别：近景。浅景深。长焦压缩空间。 构图：前景为鸵鸟脖子和机器人腰部以上位置，处于画面中心线右侧，占据画面二分之一面积；背景为城市街道以及远处追来的丧尸尸潮，处于画面中心线左侧。拉伸透视，人物主体与远方延伸的街道形成动态对角。 

运镜手法：固定机位，跟随随拍摄主体。 

画面内容：机器人面部LED屏幕保持蓝色冷酷表情，骑乘着鸵鸟面对镜头方向，位于街道中央，沿着笔直的公路狂奔，鸵鸟高速奔跑，翅膀微张，双脚交替蹬踏地面身体带有颠簸起伏，高速移动带有动态模糊感。在其身后的远处，有一片尾随着他们的丧尸尸潮，丧尸们面对镜头方向追杀机器人与鸵鸟。丧尸们嘶吼声此起彼伏，移动速率前后不一。街道上散落着触目惊心的尸体和血迹。机器人左手握住鸵鸟脖子，右手从身后掏出一根雷管炸弹，单手握持，右手大拇指用力按下顶部启动按钮，炸弹开始充能并发光，随即往身后高高抛出，右手顺势按压住自己帽子，轻微耸肩低头等待爆炸。片刻后炸弹从画面上方入画，精准的落在尸潮之中并爆炸。炸弹的威力惊人，爆炸的火光绚丽而巨大，丧尸们被炸飞，瞬间产生高能冲击波向四周扩散，卷起地面的灰尘与。爆炸后0.5秒，强劲的冲击波将鸵鸟与机器人瞬间推出画面。伴随迎面而来的强大推力，画面产生剧烈抖动与失焦。

Sunlight pours into an old house's living room. Curtain shadows spill across the floor, a steaming tea cup on the coffee table reflects the window, a family portrait on the wall is illuminated, a rocking chair sways gently, and a small dog lounges lazily by the window.

[Shot 1 - Low Angle / Forest Volumetric Light]
A low-angle shot looking up at a primeval forest in the early morning. Morning sunlight penetrates the dense fog, forming distinct Tyndall beams (volumetric light rays) that project precisely onto the damp moss and dew on the ground.

[Shot 2 - Extreme Long Shot / Aurora and Reflections]
An extreme long shot depicting an Icelandic black sand beach under the polar night. Vibrant emerald and deep violet auroras dance like silk across the night sky, reflected in the mirror-like black tide below.

[Shot 3 - Medium Shot / Architectural Geometric Shadows]
Cut to a medium shot of a minimalist building interior. The harsh mid-day sun refracts through huge Venetian blinds, casting a sharp, high-contrast matrix of black-and-white linear shadows across the marble floor and white walls.

[Shot 4 - Zoom Out / Freeze-Frame Silhouette at Sunset]
The camera pulls back extremely slowly. The black-and-white shadows are swallowed by the blood-red sun slowly sinking outside the window. The entire building is carved into a stark silhouette, freezing in the red glow.

Dolly push-pull shooting a spinning gyroscope. Shallow depth of field bearing close-up. Overhead mechanical panorama. Lateral tracking with gear bokeh.

Shot 1 (Extreme Close-Up):
In a silent, pitch-black frame, a beam of icy ultraviolet probe laser suddenly pierces down. The scene opens with a millimeter-scale extreme close-up, focusing strictly on a single grain of red Martian sand.

Shot 2 (Microscopic Push-in):
Defying conventions, the camera pushes in like a microscope, plunging infinitely deeper beyond what the naked eye can see. The rocky texture on the sand's surface begins to magnify endlessly, looming like a vast earthbound grand canyon before our eyes.

Shot 3 (Panning / Tracking Sweep):
The microscopic lens glides smoothly across the coarse surface of mineral crystals, reflecting metallic shades of dark red and ethereal blue. The dried-up iron oxide crystals wedged in the crevices resemble bone-dry ancient riverbeds.

Shot 4 (Rack Focus):
The camera holds its position, rapidly shifting focus through an extremely shallow depth of field. Shifting away from the blurred tip of the surface dust, it suddenly locks onto an unknown mineral particle glimmering with an eerie, faint glow deep within.

Shot 5 (Action Capture):
A micro-airburst from the probe's mechanical arm blows across. Under the close-up lens, a few specks of Martian dust—tens of thousands of times finer than flour—hover weightlessly in the vacuum, rotating slowly like a miniature red nebula in deep space.

Shot 6 (Smooth Pull-out):
The camera begins to pull back steadily as the field of view expands. The canyon-like textures converge once more, transforming back into minerals, and finally into rock.

Shot 7 (Wide Shot Freeze-Frame):
The camera pulls all the way back to reveal a full wide shot of the probe's base. That seemingly ordinary grain of red sand rests quietly on a metallic stage, framed against the desolate, silent, and endless orange-red Martian desert stretching beyond the rover's wheels.

The drone rises from a misty mountainside, breaking through a thin fog layer. Dense green treetops fill both sides of frame, morning light catching moisture on the canopy. The camera keeps ascending and pushing forward, clearing the tree line. Rolling dark-green ridges and a winding stream in the valley below come into view. The drone crosses the final ridgeline — the vista suddenly opens wide.
Beyond the ridge, the terrain transitions into vast golden rice terraces. The drone maintains the same speed and altitude, gliding over geometric layers of flooded paddy fields stepping downward. Irrigation channels thread between plots like silver lines. Afternoon sunlight turns the water surfaces into scattered gold reflections. The camera continues forward — at the far edge of the fields, a blue body of water appears on the horizon.
The terraces give way to a wide highland lake. The drone passes over the shoreline and glides above the water, which shifts from jade green at the shallows to deep blue at the center. The still surface mirrors the surrounding snow-capped mountains and clouds. The drone slowly gains altitude, gradually revealing the full shape of the lake and the mountain skyline encircling it, settling into a wide panoramic frame.

Shot 1 — extreme close-up of the hands: she wears a pair of metal-framed reading glasses, holding a silver sewing needle in her slightly trembling yet steady right hand, while her left hand slowly guides the cotton thread through the needle's eye. The cracked skin at the edges of her fingernails and the prominent knuckles on her fingers, built up from years of labor, are clearly visible. As the needle tip pierces through the dark blue cotton fabric, a tiny wisp of lint is pulled up.

Shot 2 — medium close-up of the face: sunlight strikes her face from the side, illuminating every wrinkle with sharp clarity. Two light brown age spots are visible on her forehead. She squints slightly, fully absorbed in her needlework, a serene smile resting at the corners of her mouth.

Shot 3 — slowly pulls back to a medium shot and then to a full shot: she sits in an old rattan chair, with a bamboo sewing basket at her feet. A cup of tea that has already gone cold sits on the windowsill. The shadow of the persimmon tree outside falls upon her, gently swaying in the breeze.

Medium front shot, full symmetry with mirror reflection. The man curls both dumbbells upward in powerful alternating reps, biceps swelling with each contraction, veins surfacing across forearms. Jaw clenched, short sharp exhales, sweat sheen building on skin. Camera holds steady with subtle handheld micro-shake matching the exertion rhythm.
Same position, time jump. He pauses between sets, one dumbbell resting on his thigh. His free hand grabs the hem of his T-shirt and lifts it to wipe sweat from his forehead and brow in one rough drag — exposing a flash of abdominal muscles. He drops the shirt, exhales long, blinks slowly. Breathing still elevated but recovering. Camera same framing, static.
Same position, time jump to session end. He bends slightly at the knees, lowers both dumbbells to the rubber floor with a controlled descent — a dull metallic thud on contact. He straightens up, rolls both shoulders back, flexes his fingers open and closed to release the grip tension. Stands still for a beat, chest rising and falling deeply, staring at his reflection. A faint look of satisfaction settles on his face. Camera slowly pulls back to a wider medium shot during the final exhale.

A low-angle side-tracking shot at eye level follows a little girl darting through a park carpeted with golden maple leaves. Her red scarf trails behind her as she laughs, kicking up a swirl of amber leaves. She runs toward a wooden bench — camera holds on the spinning leaves she left behind.
The swirling leaves settle onto a canvas. Pull back to reveal a young woman painter sitting at an easel among the same row of golden trees, capturing the autumn canopy in oil strokes. Medium shot, dappled sunlight on her hands. She dips her brush — a drop of amber paint falls from the bristle tip.
The falling paint drop becomes a drop of honey drizzling onto a fresh pastry. A middle-aged baker arranges maple-leaf-shaped cookies on a wooden tray inside a warm bakery with fogged windows. Through the glass, golden trees line the street outside. He slides the tray onto a display shelf — camera follows through the glass window to the street.
Outside the bakery, an elderly man in a tweed coat walks a golden retriever along a cobblestone sidewalk blanketed with fallen leaves. The dog playfully noses through a leaf pile. Low-angle tracking shot at the dog's level. A gust of wind lifts a cluster of leaves across the frame.
The wind-carried leaves land on the surface of a still pond in a botanical garden. A teenage boy sits at the water's edge, reading a book with yellowed pages, his bicycle leaning against a rust-colored oak behind him. Reflection of golden foliage shimmers on the water. He looks up from his book toward the distance.
Reverse shot reveals what he sees — the same little girl from the opening, now far down the tree-lined path, still running with her red scarf, growing smaller among the towering golden canopy. Wide shot, late afternoon sun casting long amber shadows. Leaves continue to drift slowly as the scene breathes in stillness.
人物运动: 日常行为,运动体育,表演艺术

题目:
高度写实，室内篮球馆，同一场五对五比赛
全场远景。 高角度俯拍，十人落位，控卫持球站在弧顶举手比战术。
控卫突破。 场边低角度跟拍，控卫接挡拆变向加速切入，球鞋拧转地板，突入罚球线区域抬头看见篮下空当。
中锋卡位。 篮下仰拍，中锋背身顶开防守人，右手高举过顶五指张开要球。
空接扣篮·慢镜头。 升格慢放。控卫直传球旋转飞过头顶，中锋起跳单手最高点接球顺势砸筐，篮筐剧烈抖动，篮网翻卷弹出。
观众欢呼。 看台正面，一排观众弹起挥手呐喊，前排小男孩骑在父亲肩上挥毛巾。
记分牌。 电子记分牌特写，比分从"6:5"跳为"8:5"，蜂鸣器短响。镜头下摇回球场，双方球员各自归位，比赛继续。

Solitary pianist in empty concert hall. Seven shots: wide piano center stage no audience. Fingers on keys close-up. Hammers striking strings slow motion inside piano. Pianist's face eyes closed, tear on cheek. Reverse wide showing vast empty hall. Single vibrating string macro. Pull back to original wide as final note fades. Seven shots capturing isolation and devotion

Inside a glass-walled conference room, an Asian businesswoman swipes through an interactive touchscreen display, presenting dynamic charts to colleagues. The screen's glow reflects off surrounding glass walls. Medium shot slowly pushing in toward the glowing screen until the blue light fills the entire frame.
The blue light dissolves and reshapes into orange welding sparks — match cut on color and light intensity.A dimly lit industrial factory floor. A young male engineer in a hard hat stands before a massive robotic arm, controlling it via tablet. Precision welding sparks scatter across dark steel. Low-angle slow orbit shot. The robotic arm swings past camera, creating a momentary whip-pan blur.
The motion blur clears to reveal warm golden sunlight — whip pan transition matching the arm's swing direction.A city park at golden hour. An elderly white-haired man sits on a wooden bench, video-calling his granddaughter on a smartwatch. Sunset light spills across the small screen and his gentle smile. Camera slowly pulls back, shallow depth of field, revealing the peaceful scene.

A girl calls her mother on the phone. Shot 1: girl in a rainy London phone booth. Shot 2: mother in a sunny kitchen in Beijing answering. Shot 3: girl smiles hearing mom's voice. Shot 4: mother tears up hearing daughter is safe. Two continents connected by voice

微距镜头，多支金属颜料管的管口依次挤出浓稠油画颜料，落在纯白亚麻画布上。钛白、镉红、群青、铬黄彼此缠绕推挤，遵循流体力学缓慢卷曲融合。颜料表面反射出画室天窗投下的冷白自然光。镜头缓缓下沉，贴近画布纹理——颜料漫过布面边缘，向下淌落。
淌落的稠液转为滚烫的彩色釉料，从陶瓷窑炉的坩埚口倾泻而下，浇覆在一只旋转中的素胎花瓶表面。微距捕捉釉料沿着瓶身弧面流淌的轨迹——铜红釉与天青釉在高温下相遇、渗透，瓶身旋转带动釉面离心展开，一缕釉丝被甩离瓶口，飞入空中。
飞离的釉丝化为一滴靛蓝染料，落入静止的清水缸中。微距俯拍视角。染料入水的瞬间炸开为丝状，向四周舒展扩散。随后一滴茜红、一滴藤黄相继滴入，三色在水中交织，水面微微震颤。

高角度全景俯拍。摄影机从古堡穹顶向下俯瞰整个战斗空间——南瓜头骑士站在大厅中央，长剑划出弧形寒光轨迹，连续劈砍；床单幽灵在四周石柱与蛛网密布的墙壁之间穿梭闪避。地面碎石随剑风崩飞，烛台被气流扑灭又重新燃起。
低角度近地仰拍，机位切至地面碎石堆旁。南瓜头骑士的铁靴从镜头前方跨过，落地震起尘土。仰视视角下，他举起长剑至最高点猛然劈下。剑刃斩入床单幽灵刚刚穿墙闪出的位置，击碎石墙表面，碎屑向镜头飞溅。幽灵从骑士身后的墙面渗出，眼珠快速转动锁定骑士后背。
中景侧面跟焦环绕镜头，摄影机与两者保持等距缓慢旋转。南瓜头骑士察觉身后异动，急速转身反手横扫；幽灵贴地飘行躲过剑锋，床单边缘被剑风撩起翻卷。
运动饮料广告：运动员大汗跑步。慢动作拧瓶盖。仰头畅饮水珠滑。产品旋转"POWER UP 能量焕发 ¥8.9"

清晨5:30，固定机位，城市天际线全景。冷蓝晨曦勾勒建筑轮廓，延时以慢速启动，光线缓缓爬上建筑立面。晨光急速席卷城市，云层飞速流动，阴影快速缩短旋转，定格在上午明亮暖调中。

同一机位，午后建筑群。云影以正常延时速度掠过玻璃幕墙，阴影匀速偏移。云层急速翻涌，阴影快速拉长扫过街道。金色夕阳光线在建筑立面上最后一次横扫，玻璃逐块闪烁反光。


黄昏转夜幕，同一机位。写字楼灯光逐层亮起，灯光从低层蔓延至顶层，全部亮起，定格在璀璨夜景。

足球赛：中场长传跟球弧线。前锋胸部停球慢动作。转身过人。球门网后射门入网球网抖动

中秋之夜，家里的客厅灯火通明热闹非凡，圆桌上摆满了红烧肉、清蒸鱼、糖醋排骨和各色时蔬，中间放着一盒打开的广式双黄白莲蓉月饼。爷爷正在给五岁的小孙子夹一块排骨，孙子双手捧着碗眼巴巴地看着筷子的方向。第二个镜头突然切到万里之外——在伦敦一间狭小的学生公寓里，女儿独自坐在书桌前，面前是一碗刚泡好的方便面和一个从中国超市买来的散装月饼，笔记本电脑屏幕上是微信视频通话的画面，对面是家里热闹的餐桌。她用筷子挑起面条但没有吃，眼睛盯着屏幕里家人的笑脸。第三个镜头切回国内——爷爷举起酒杯凑近手机镜头，满脸皱纹堆成笑容大声说着什么。第四个镜头回到伦敦——女儿眼眶泛红但嘴角上扬，用力点头笑着回应，公寓窗外是冷蓝色的英国夜空和远处教堂的尖顶
人物运动: 日常行为,社会互动,情绪表情

题目:
Medium shot, singer faces camera in a dark studio lit by cyan and magenta neon strips. Sharp head turn to the right on the beat. The neon light catches the "NOVA" lettering on the back of a black leather jacket as the singer begins to turn. Camera pushes in slowly.
Close-up of the singer's hand dragging across the studio wall. Fingertips leave trails of liquid chrome that crawl and spread across the surface like mercury, pulsing in sync with the bass. The reflection of the singer's face is distorted in the chrome surface.
Wide shot from behind, singer center-frame, arms spread. The chrome from the walls now creeps across the floor toward the singer's boots, forming a mirror pool. Overhead neon rigs flicker between warm amber and cool violet. "NOVA" text on the jacket glows faintly, matching the chrome's shimmer.
Extreme close-up of the singer's face, eyes shut then snapping open. The iris reflects the liquid chrome environment. Pull-out reveals the entire studio has become a chrome shell — walls, floor, ceiling — with the singer as the only non-metallic element. Final frame freezes as the neon cuts to white.

一位年轻上班族的通勤跨场景记录，同一人物穿越五个截然不同的空间。第一个镜头：他在家中厨房站着快速吃完最后一口吐司，用手背擦嘴，顺手拿起挂在椅背上的公文包，厨房背景是暖黄色的灯光和洗碗池里还没来得及洗的杯子。第二个镜头：他推开公寓大门走出来，外面正下着小雨，他从门口的伞架上抽出一把黑色折叠伞撑开，画面色调突然从室内暖黄变成室外的冷灰蓝。第三个镜头：公交站台上他和几个上班族一起等车，低头看手机上显示的时间，雨滴从伞边滴落，背景有一辆公交车正在远处驶来。第四个镜头：公交车内他坐在靠窗位置，窗外是不断后退的城市街景——高楼、路灯、行人都被雨水模糊成流动的色块，他的表情从焦虑慢慢变得平静。第五个镜头：写字楼内他走进一间开放式办公室，把湿伞放在门口的桶里，坐到自己的工位上打开笔记本电脑，屏幕亮起的白光照在他的脸上

The astronaut's boot steps off the last rung of the lander ladder onto red soil, pressing a clear footprint. Low-angle camera at ground level captures the boot sole compacting Martian dust — fine particles bounce up and drift slowly in low gravity. The astronaut stands still. The camera tilts up from the footprint, past the white spacesuit torso, stopping at the helmet visor — the visor reflects the red Martian wasteland.
Same location, the astronaut has walked several steps forward. Medium shot follows his back as each boot leaves a trail of footprints extending across the red surface. He stops at an open flat area and slowly turns to face the camera. Olympus Mons rises on the distant horizon behind him. He retrieves a rolled flag from his side and unfurls the pole with both hands.
The astronaut drives the flagpole into Martian soil and stamps the base firm with his boot heel. The flag unfurls — printed with an Earth unity symbol, belonging to no nation. He steps back twice, standing beside the flag in a half-turn toward the camera. No wind exists; the flag holds its shape on a rigid support frame. The camera slowly pulls back and rises, expanding from a medium shot to a wide panorama — the astronaut, the flag, the trail of footprints behind him, and Olympus Mons in the distance together form the final frame.

大全景远景，机位在山谷对面远处。一座山峰占据画面右侧，山顶站着一个渺小的人影——背包徒步者，面朝画面左侧延展的广袤森林。云层裂开一道缝隙，动漫风格的体积光束倾泻而下，为森林树冠染上明亮的金绿色。整体构图强调人物在自然中的渺小感，天空占画面上方三分之二，云朵以吉卜力风格的柔软体积感缓慢移动。
机位切至山顶，中景侧后方45度角。徒步者的背影与侧脸轮廓清晰可见——短发被山风吹起，衣摆和背包带随风飘动。他站在岩石边缘，一只手搭在背包肩带上。画面中景深分明：前景是脚下的碎石与野草，中景为人物，远景为色彩层次分明的森林延伸至地平线。阳光从云层缝隙变换角度，森林色调在画面中实时从深绿过渡至金黄。
机位切至正面低角度仰拍。镜头从略低于山顶岩石边缘的位置向上拍摄徒步者，天空作为整个背景。他的正脸迎着光线，头发和衣服被迎面的风持续吹动。表情安静，眼中映着远处的风景。阳光完全穿透云层，在他身后形成放射状光线，风将几片树叶从画面下方卷起掠过身侧。他微微闭眼深吸一口气，嘴角轻轻上扬。

A designer sketches in a studio. Cut to a factory worker operating a CNC machine cutting the same shape. Cut to a customer unboxing the finished product at home. Cut to the designer smiling seeing a 5-star review on screen. Four shots tracing an object from concept to consumer across four locations

A single red rose goes through its lifecycle in four shots. Shot 1: tight bud in morning light. Shot 2: half-open bloom at noon. Shot 3: full blossom at golden hour. Shot 4: petals falling at dusk. Same rose, same vase, four time jumps — only the flower and light change
清晨的阳光洒在简约的卧室里，一位年轻中国男子站在那里。他缓缓地扣上白色衬衫的纽扣，镜头特写衬衫面料自然地垂落在身上，双手流畅地扣着纽扣。随后向卧室走去，对着镜子满意地看了看，最后转了个圈。文字“空调衫 ¥199 舒适轻薄”。干净的自然光线。

Wolf pack hunts at twilight on snowy plain — seven shots of coordinated predator movement. Wide formation. Alpha's breath in cold air. Pack accelerates. Close-up of powerful hind legs. They fan out. One wolf feints left. The pack converges from all sides — cut before contact, outcome left to imagination

烈日炙烤的苍茫非洲荒野，枯黄草原一望无际，燥热空气微微扭曲晃动。镜头缓缓向前推进，草丛深处，一只雄狮压低身形蛰伏隐匿，茂密的深色鬃毛与枯草完美融合，在阴影中静静蓄力。侧机位低角度拍摄，雄狮目光锐利如刀、死死锁定远方猎物，浑身肌肉紧绷，整片旷野静谧荒芜，暗藏张力。电影级色调，自然光影，浅景深特写。不要出现多只狮子，不要卡通风格，不要文字水印。

同一只深色鬃毛雄狮瞬间爆发冲刺，庞大的身躯带起滚滚沙尘，疾驰穿梭在非洲枯黄草原之上。近距离跟拍特写，每一步落脚力量感十足，四肢腾空、肌肉线条剧烈收缩，速度感与压迫感拉满。锋利凶狠的眼神紧盯前方，威武的鬃毛随极速奔跑和狂风肆意飞扬，獠牙微张，风声裹挟旷野怒吼。运动模糊背景，高速摄影质感，侧面跟随机位。不要静止画面，不要多只动物，不要肢体变形。

航拍镜头缓缓拉高俯瞰，同一只深色鬃毛雄狮如一道金色闪电疾驰穿过辽阔非洲草原，孤身穿梭苍茫旷野，身后扬起一道细长尘迹。夕阳金色光线斜洒大地，天地光影交融，壮阔地平线延伸至远方。最终缓慢定格，野性、力量与绝对自由的荒野盛世画面。大全景构图，航拍视角，电影级宽画幅。不要近景特写，不要人类建筑，不要多只动物。

A Beijing hutong. Ground-level wide-angle shot, frame slightly tilted. Five kids play football in an alley flanked by gray walls. The boy in yellow cuts diagonally forward dribbling the ball, three defenders rush in from both sides to block him. The kid in red slides in for a tackle, kicking up a cloud of dust and gravel. The football sits at the lower-right golden-ratio position in frame. The camera tracks quickly side to side following the ball. The rising dust spreads and obscures the edges of the frame.
A southern town river pond. The dust transforms into splashing water — three shirtless boys leap off a stone arch bridge into green river water, each in a different pose: one in a cannonball tuck, one with arms spread wide, one pinching his nose falling straight down. Wide-angle low shot near the water surface looking up, the splash explodes toward the camera, sunlight piercing through the water droplets creating tiny rainbows. Two kids who didn't dare jump crouch on the bank, nervously peering down.
 A rural threshing ground. Under golden-hour side light, a group of girls jump rubber-band rope on an open concrete yard. Two girls hold the elastic band at each end while three in the middle take turns jumping and flipping, floral skirts and braids swinging with the motion. Low-angle side shot captures fine chaff dust rising beneath their feet as they leap. In the blurred background, an adult rides past on a bicycle. One girl catches her foot on the band and tumbles, the rest burst into laughter.

高度写实，慢镜头跟拍，主体始终为同一个中国男孩与一只足球，跨越三处不同场景，捕捉足球腾空与接球的瞬间。
阳光公园。树叶间洒下斑驳光影，男孩奔跑中一脚将足球踢向空中。慢镜头跟拍足球升起——球体缓慢旋转，表面的纹路和草屑清晰可辨，阳光穿过树冠在球面上投下流动的光斑。镜头随球上升，男孩在下方抬头追踪球的轨迹，嘴角咧开兴奋的笑容，奔跑中的头发一根根被定格在空气中。足球升至最高点开始下落——穿过一片树叶缝隙的光柱。
黄昏沙滩。足球从画面上方落入海边黄昏的天空中，同一个男孩赤脚奔跑在湿润沙滩上，仰头准备接球。慢镜头捕捉他每一步踩在沙面上溅起的细沙与水珠，脚趾抓地的细节。足球旋转下落，男孩的瞳孔中倒映着球体。他跳起用胸部停球——球触碰胸口的瞬间，T恤面料形成凹陷涟漪，足球弹起后他用膝盖轻巧颠起，身后是橙红色的落日贴着海平面。
夜晚街灯下。足球再次腾空，旋转着飞过一盏路灯的光晕，水汽和小飞虫在灯光中被照亮。同一个男孩站在社区水泥球场上，周围空无一人，只有路灯将他的影子拉长。他后退两步，仰头注视下落的球，脸上的兴奋和专注与白天一模一样。球落至额头高度——他精准地用头一顶，足球弹向夜空再次升起。镜头跟球上升，从男孩脸上的笑容拉远，直到足球变为路灯光晕中一个旋转的小小轮廓。

Montage of three dog owners in different parks walking their dogs at dawn. Shot 1: man with dalmatian on a beach. Shot 2: woman with poodle in a city park.
